messages:
anita_capacity: Quick proposal — instead of the usual fixed-VM headroom ask, I want to request quota increases based on a safety-margin model tied to 3 traffic scenarios (baseline, seasonal-peak, 99th pct spike). Short ask: agree on margins, then I open cloud support cases per account/region.

josh_infra: can you sketch the numbers? we should avoid repeating past underprovisioning in ap-southeast.

anita_capacity: yeah. rough plan: baseline = current steady state. seasonal-peak = +30% (expected q4 holiday), spike = +70% (worst 2-hour burst). propose safety margin of +25% on top of peak for buffer when we need instant burst capacity. that gives us request targets of: baseline, baseline*1.3 (peak), baseline*1.3*1.25 (requested quota).

ryan_network: important: if we increase instance quota we also need ENI/subnet and EIP headroom in those regions. ap-southeast has vpc-eni limits that bit us before. what's the planned AZ spread?

anita_capacity: plan is multi-AZ across 3 AZs where possible. allocation heuristic: prefer AZs with available GPU capacity and spare ENI quota. I'll include per-AZ ENI counts in the ticket. rough ask per region: GPU instances, VPC ENIs, elastic IPs, and NIC quotas.

maria_eng: also consider reserved warm pool vs elastic burst spot mix. if we plan a warm pool of N instances we can keep smaller on-demand quota and rely on spot for burst, but spot availability is flaky in apac. maybe make the request conservative.

anita_capacity: good point. included in the spreadsheet are two variants: WarmPool=100 instances (steady) + BurstSpots=200; or WarmPool=200 + BurstSpots=100. cost/availability tradeoffs shown. I'm leaning toward WarmPool=150 + BurstSpots=150.

josh_infra: can you paste the sample cloud support body? makes it faster to cut/paste per account.

anita_capacity: sure — draft below (feel free to edit):
```
Hello support,

We are requesting quota increases for X account/region for our dedicated inference pool. Current baseline GPU instances: 120. We request a new quota of 120 * 1.3 * 1.25 = 195 GPU instances (all GPU types combined) to support expected peak + safety margin. Additionally, please increase the following: VPC ENIs by 220, Elastic IPs by 220, and per-account IP address quota by 300. This change is required across AZs A/B/C in region ap-southeast-1.

Reason: production inference capacity for Redwood Inference Dedicated customers — to support seasonal demand and ensure headroom for automated rollouts and failover. Planned rollout window: 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-15.

Please let us know if you need account IDs or further verification.

Thanks,
Anita on behalf of Redwood Inference Infra
```

ryan_network: add a note asking for accelerated review due to a scheduled canary the week after. support usually pushes faster with a business case and dates.

anita_capacity: good call, added that line. also adding per-AZ subnet size ask: ensure /22 or larger per AZ for allocation.

sre-bot: incident-note: last time we hit ENI limits (2025-12-12) caused 27% pod flapping in ap-southeast for 42 minutes. attaching incident ID INC-2025-3219.

maria_eng: if we submit this by EOD Monday I can start the rollout runbook and pre-warm images. small ask: confirm the instance families (a100-p4d etc) we'll request so quota covers the right SKU types.

anita_capacity: will add SKU breakdown — current mix: 60% a100-type, 30% h100-type, 10% smaller for integration. I'll send the per-SKU numbers in the ticket.

josh_infra: approve the approach. next steps: anita opens tickets for prod accounts in us-west2, eu-west1, ap-southeast-1 with the numbers. ryan to validate subnet/ENI numbers. maria to prep warm pool images. we should CC sales if this affects customers.

anita_capacity: thanks — I'll draft and post the actual support tickets here when created. marking action owners in the spreadsheet. :white_check_mark:

cloud-support-bot: Support case created: CS-87214 for ap-southeast-1 (GPU quota request). Reply will be posted here when updated.
